name: GrowChief
headline: GrowChief - Social Media Automation
short_description: Automate social media outreach with GrowChief. Marketing teams use it to schedule posts, engage audiences, and analyze performance. Connects to n8n, NestJS, Node.js, and Temporal for workflow automation.
author: growchief

sections.overview:
GrowChief is a social media automation tool designed for marketing teams to streamline outreach and engagement workflows. The platform enables scheduling of social media posts, audience engagement, and performance analysis across multiple channels. It integrates with workflow automation platforms including n8n, NestJS, Node.js, and Temporal to automate complex marketing processes. GrowChief helps marketing teams save time on repetitive tasks while maintaining consistent social media presence. The tool is built with modern development frameworks to support scalable, enterprise-level deployment.
Automate sending personalized connection requests on LinkedIn to potential leads.
Schedule follow-up messages to engage with new connections at optimal times.
Integrate with n8n to create multi-step workflows that include lead enrichment and outreach.
Use GrowChief's API to manage and process leads during specified working hours.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/growchief/growchief`
sections.usage:
```
Use GrowChief to automate social media outreach for [BUSINESS_NAME]. Schedule [NUMBER] posts per week across [PLATFORMS: e.g., LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram] with [POSTING_TIMES]. Include [CONTENT_THEMES: e.g., product updates, industry news, customer testimonials]. Set up automated engagement rules for comments and mentions using [RULES: e.g., reply to positive comments within 1 hour, thank new followers]. Generate a performance report after [TIMEFRAME: e.g., 30 days] with [METRICS: e.g., engagement rate, follower growth, click-through rate].
```
Copy

```
For EcoGlow, a sustainable skincare brand, we automated their social media outreach using GrowChief to schedule 12 posts weekly across LinkedIn, Twitter, and Instagram. The content mix included 40% product updates (e.g., new vegan moisturizer launch), 30% industry news (e.g., clean beauty trends), and 30% customer testimonials (e.g., user-generated content featuring before/after photos). We set engagement rules to reply to positive comments within 1 hour and tag followers who shared our posts. After 30 days, the engagement rate increased by 42% (from 3.1% to 4.4%), follower growth accelerated by 28% (from 5,200 to 6,656), and the click-through rate on product links reached 8.7%. The top-performing post was a customer testimonial video that generated 1,240 likes and 312 shares. The GrowChief dashboard showed that Tuesday at 10 AM and Thursday at 2 PM were the optimal posting times for this audience.
```
